subject: how to read geomorph.data.frame to RRPP

messages.author: a0f8ae60bd31a713
messages.subject: how to read geomorph.data.frame to RRPP
parts:
Hi everyone,

Perhaps this is a pretty basic question, but I can't found the solution by reading the PDFs of the package RRPP or Geomorph. I have been working with Geomorph to run basic analysis on my data. However, I'm not quite sure whether it is possible to run a mixed model anova using Geomorph? or should I instead be using package RRPP? If this is the case how can you read geomorph.data frame to RRPP?

Thanks in advanced,


Giselle

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] how to read geomorph.data.frame to RRPP
parts:
Giselle,

 

RRPP is where this would be. If you look at the vignette ‘Using RRPP’, there is an example of a mixed model.  That should guide you through some mixed model analyses.

 

Dean

Hi Dean,

Thanks for your reply. Yes, in the mean time I have found pretty good examples in RRPP Appendix S2, but I can't fit the model in RRPP, and keep obtaining the following error:

fit3  <- lm.rrpp(coords ~ logSize + leaf/stomata, data = dombeyi.gdf, print.progress = FALSE) 

Error: Data are arranged in an array rather than a matrix.  Please convert data to a matrix. 

I have tried converting my geomorph data frame Using rrpp.data.frame() function, but It seems like before converting to rrpp data frame you have to convert to a matrix. How would you do that?


Gracias,


Giselle
